name: TrueWood Lite Dark Smoke Oak Slats, Black Felt
summary: Solid rubberwood slats wrapped in real dark smoke oak veneer on three sides, backed with black acoustic felt.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec sheet overrides photo estimates: 8 slats with 27 mm (1.063 in) faces and 10.5 mm (0.413 in) rectangular felt gaps on a 37.5 mm (1.476 in) pitch give a 300 mm installed repeat, with 5 mm slats over 5 mm felt (10 mm total), rather than the 305 mm loose-panel width. Warm dark smoke oak tones are sampled from the main listing photo over black felt; procedural grain wraps over 24 in vertically, with a small edge softening for the normal map.
